statement: Rocky's mass is one hundred sixty-eight kilograms.
source_context: "My mass is one hundred sixty-eight kilograms," he says.

statement: Humans have very small mass compared to Rocky.

source_context: He told me all about his biology and how it uses metals. Heck, his blood is mercury.

statement: The ship's rotation creates artificial gravity.
source_context: He thinks it over. "You ship has much science!"

statement: Rocky can create xenonite from materials.
source_context: "I bring materials to make xenonite. Can make any shape."

statement: Rocky's sleep pattern is linked to pack instinct.
source_context: He told me all about his biology... His sleep pattern is a fear of sleeping alone, which the narrator connects to pack instinct.

statement: Rocky believes his people rushed ship construction, leading to quality issues.
source_context: *I try so many times. Fail so many times. Not good at science.*

statement: Rocky understands Eridian time units, where 7,776 seconds equals one Eridian day.
source_context: *Seven thousand seven hundred and seventy-six seconds is* ♩♫♩♪♪*.

statement: Rocky has been in the system for 46 Earth years.
source_context: *I am here forty-six Earth years, yes.*

statement: Rocky believes he is not scientifically inclined and that 'science Eridians died.'
source_context: *I am repair Eridian. I not science Eridian. Smart smart smart science Eridians died.*

statement: Rocky misunderstands the phrase 'Things in tunnel is last things.'
Rocky confuses Earth units with Eridian units, attributing his struggles to 'Earth math.'
source_context: *Always Earth units. You are bad at math, so always Earth units.*

statement: The narrator learns that Rocky's species has a lifespan of up to 689 Earth years.
